material_criteria: The provided material must meet or exceed the specified size requirements.
If the provided material fails in quality assessment test, it is the responsibility of the vendor to replace it.

Mill test certificates should be provided by the vendor at the time of delivery. Certificate should include Mill Heat Number, Lot Number, Chemical Composition, mechanical testing, Hardness, IGC Test result, etc.
Raw material should be of reputed make and standard only. Preferably Tata Steel, Jindal Stainless and SAIL (Steel Authority of India Limited).
The provided material should match the required material grade and size required.
Any scratches and uneven shape will not be acceptable.
Dents and bends on the surface of material will not be acceptable.

If there is any material requirement of non-standard sizes then the vendor will be informed about it. Vendor should supply the non-standard sized material by considering 10 to 15 mm of extra allowance on the size mentioned in the RFQ.

For material verification, MakerStrive will test the supplied material in the lab by taking a test specimen from each lot/heat. Material properties mentioned on the MTC supplied by the vendor are expected to be in good agreement with lab test reports. In case there is a deviation in the material properties mentioned on the MTC from the lab test report data, the vendor has to replace the entire lot of material at no extra cost.
The final cost will be dependent on the raw material total weight and its rate.
